task: Build mobile-accessible web-based animation studio for TRIPPEDD
resume_brief: Build a mobile-first web animation studio as a web_static artifact (public link). v1 needs: video timeline editor (scrub, in/out marks), audio waveform view, frame-by-frame stepping, all touch-friendly. Embed review-size video. Generate EDL/ffmpeg commands for actual edits. Tool integrations (FlipaClip-style frame animation, CapCut-style timeline, Canva-style text overlay, rembg background removal) in v2. 3D repos in v3. Deploy via artifact.create_web_static with slug 'trippedd-studio-mobile' or similar. The owner (Real) will open it on his Android phone.
notes: v1 COMPLETE. Artifact pocket-edit-studio built and verified (desktop+phone audits passed). Features: video player (v6b review URL preloaded, editable), timeline w/ 21 color-coded scene markers, canvas waveform (1200 peaks), frame stepper (30fps MM:SS:FF), in/out marks w/ EDL ffmpeg export, timestamped notes w/ copy-all. All in-memory (static artifact, no localStorage). Share not yet enabled — parent must share for public link.
